units.source_text: 且说源氏公子回到二条院私邸，看见豆蔻年华的紫姬，长得异常美好。

en.t: Now Genji returned to his private residence at Nijo-in and saw that the young Lady Murasaki had grown extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 她脸上也有红晕，但和末摘花的红迥不相同，甚是娇艳。

en.t: There was a blush on her face too, but it was utterly unlike Suetsumuhana's redness, and was very charming and radiant.

units.source_text: 她身穿一件深紫色夹里无纹白地童式女衫，潇洒风流，天真烂漫，非常可爱。

en.t: She wore a childlike woman's robe of plain white fabric lined in deep purple, and looked graceful, elegant, innocent, lively, and exceedingly lovable.

units.source_text: 她的外祖母墨守古风，不给她的牙齿染黑[\[22\]](#part1335.html#m22)。

en.t: Her maternal grandmother had stubbornly kept to old-fashioned ways and had not allowed her teeth to be blackened[\[22\]](#part1335.html#m22).

units.source_text: 最近给她染黑了，并且加以整饰。

en.t: Recently, however, they had been blackened, and she had been further groomed and adorned.

units.source_text: 眉毛也拔净涂黑，相貌十分美丽清秀。

en.t: Her eyebrows had also been plucked clean and painted dark, making her appearance remarkably beautiful and refined.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想道：“我真是自作自受！

en.t: Genji thought, "I truly bring all this trouble on myself!

units.source_text: 何必去找那些女人，自寻烦恼？

en.t: Why must I go seeking out those women and invite distress for myself?

units.source_text: 为什么不在家里守着这个可怜可爱的人儿呢？”

en.t: Why do I not stay at home and keep watch over this dear, pitiable, lovely person?"

units.source_text: 他就照例和她一起弄玩偶。

en.t: Then, as usual, he played with dolls together with her.

units.source_text: 紫姬画了些画，着了颜色，又随意画种种有趣的形象。

en.t: Lady Murasaki drew some pictures, colored them in, and then freely sketched all sorts of amusing figures.

units.source_text: 源氏公子也和她一起画。

en.t: Genji also drew together with her.

units.source_text: 他画一个头发很长的女子，在她的鼻尖上点一点红。

en.t: He drew a woman with very long hair and placed a small red dot on the tip of her nose.

units.source_text: 即使在画中，这相貌也很难看。

en.t: Even in the picture, that face looked quite ugly.
